## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is clear and bounded.
- [ ] Backward-compatibility impact is explained.
- [ ] Determinism and refusal paths are considered where relevant.
- [ ] Tests and docs are updated.
- [ ] Changelog entry added when relevant.
